title: Tempo by Hilton Times Square Unveils Suite Takeover Inspired by Tony Award-Winning Musical, The Lost Boys
summary: Tempo by Hilton Times Square is teaming up with Broadway’s The Lost Boys to debut an immersive suite takeover inspired by the hit musical.

Guests can step into the world of the four‑time Tony Award‑winning musical through an immersive suite experience, themed cocktails and exclusive perks


- **Tempo by Hilton Times Square, the stylish and contemporary lifestyle hotel located in the heart of Manhattan’s Theater District and adjacent to the historic Palace Theatre, is teaming up with Broadway’s *The Lost Boys* to debut an immersive suite takeover inspired by the hit musical.**
- **Available for stays now through September 14, 2027, the one-of-a-kind suite transports guests to Santa Carla, a sun-soaked boardwalk town that transforms into vampire territory after dark.**
- **The experience extends beyond the suite to Highball, where exclusive food and beverage offerings bring the production’s playful, after-dark energy to the hotel’s bar and lounge, while guests who book *The Lost Boys* Suite will receive additional perks designed exclusively for the collaboration.**


**NEW YORK** –[Tempo by Hilton Times Square](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/nyctepo-tempo-new-york-times-square/) , the stylish and contemporary lifestyle hotel located in the heart of Manhattan’s Theater District and adjacent to the historic Palace Theatre, is teaming up with Broadway’s[The Lost Boys](https://www.lostboysmusical.com/) to debut an immersive suite takeover inspired by the hit musical. **Available for stays now through Sept. 14, 2027** , the one-of-a-kind suite transports guests to Santa Carla, a sun-soaked boardwalk town that transforms into vampire territory after dark. In celebration of the most Tony Award-winning new musical of 2026, this exclusive experience provides fans a rare opportunity to stay steps from the show and continue the experience long after the curtain falls.


-
-


Tempo by Hilton Times Square - The Lost Boys - Bedroom (L) & Living Room (R)


The collaboration brings the imaginative world of *The Lost Boys* beyond the stage, offering guests a new way to engage with Times Square’s theater culture from the center of it all. Designed with photo-worthy moments throughout, the suite invites guests to capture and share their own Lost Boys-inspired adventure and layers theatrical design with 1980s nostalgia, from vintage entertainment touches to boardwalk-inspired details that nod to the cult classic’s sun-soaked, after-dark world.


Blending the hotel’s modern aesthetic with *The Lost Boys’* distinctly seaside style, the suite brings the production to life through immersive design elements. A mural of a glowing Ferris wheel set against a starry night sky anchors the bedroom, while a graffiti-style “We’re Inviting You In” mural sets the tone in the living area. Throughout the suite, guests will discover nods to the era, including a vintage cabinet television and VCR stocked with 1980s VHS tapes, a record player and vinyl collection, and a classic beachside bench - creating an atmosphere that balances amusement park nostalgia with the after-dark intrigue of *The Lost Boys* .


-
-


Tempo by Hilton Times Square - The Lost Boys - Top: Living Room
Bottom: Vintage Cabinet Television (L) & Record Player (R)


“Broadway is one of the defining experiences for visitors to New York City, and with our location in the center of the Theater District next to the Palace Theatre, we're uniquely positioned to bring guests even closer to the shows they love," said Matthew Belsito, director of marketing, Tempo by Hilton Times Square. " *The Lost Boys* has captivated audiences with its imaginative storytelling and distinctive visual world, making it a natural fit for an immersive hotel experience. Together, we've created a stay that invites guests to step inside the story while discovering the vibrant spirit of Times Square."


“We have been overwhelmed by the enthusiasm and outpouring of love from the audiences coming to see *The Lost Boys* and are thrilled that Tempo by Hilton Times Square has created this immersive experience that allows our fans to extend their time in Santa Carla through the night,” said producers James Carpinello, Marcus Chait, and Patrick Wilson, *The Lost Boys* .


The experience extends beyond the suite to Highball, the hotel’s bar and lounge, where exclusive food and beverage offerings showcase the production’s playful, after-dark energy. One signature cocktail, a clarified Canerock Jamaican rum with lime juice and demerara, is topped with red cotton candy to create a dramatic “bleeding” effect as the cotton candy dissolves - a playful nod to one of *The Lost Boys’* most iconic moments.


A special prix fixe menu is also available, providing guests with a three-course savory experience. Choose between Four Cheese Arancini or Spicy Tiny Crispy Rice as a starter, followed by Cheese Ravioli, Roasted Chicken Breast, or Korean BBQ Glazed Salmon as a main, and conclude the meal with an Old-Fashioned Rice Pudding topped with cinnamon, gummy worms, raspberry, and caramel popcorn. Paying homage to a memorable scene from the show, the dessert arrives in a Chinese takeout-style rice container with edible chopsticks, mimicking the moment when a seemingly innocent rice dish gets an unexpected surprise.


Tempo by Hilton Times Square - The Lost Boys - Merch


Guests who book *The Lost Boys* Suite will receive additional perks designed exclusively for the collaboration, including a curated merchandise package featuring apparel and accessories inspired by the show, a themed welcome sweet treat, and a food and beverage credit to enjoy during the stay.


Whether visiting New York for a weekend getaway or planning a theater-filled escape, *The Lost Boys* Suite offers fans a new way to experience one of Broadway's most celebrated productions. For more information about *The Lost Boys* Suite or to book a stay, please visit the hotel’s[website](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/nyctepo-tempo-new-york-times-square/) . *THE LOST BOYS* tickets are available at[BroadwayDirect.com](https://tickets.broadwaydirect.com/tickets/series/843567?utm_source=show_site&utm_medium=web&utm_campaign=lostboys&_gl=1*4fx2vx*_ga*OTg2MTE2MDc2LjE3NTk4NDc2Nzk.*_ga_3NDM00396D*czE3NjM0MDEyOTUkbzUkZzAkdDE3NjM0MDEyOTUkajYwJGwwJGg5NjY3MjczMzU.) , or at The Palace Theatre box office.


To book the suite, please emailNYCTE_RES@hilton.com . Read more about Tempo by Hilton at[stories.hilton.com/tempo](https://stories.hilton.com/tempo) .

## About Tempo by Hilton Times Square


Opened August 2023 as Hilton’s first hotel within its new stylish and contemporary lifestyle brand, Tempo by Hilton. Spread across 36 floors in the TSX Broadway, a 46-story tower featuring the hotel, experiential retail, entertainment spaces, and the historic Palace Theatre, each of the hotel’s 661 guestrooms feature a dedicated Get Ready Zone for personal organization or working, a spacious bathroom with Bluetooth speakers and Apotheke bath amenities, and floor-to-ceiling windows. In addition to a state-of-the-art fitness center and signature hydration station, dedicated Wellness Rooms feature a Peloton Bike and access to a library of digital content, a yoga mat, and resistance bands. The hotel is also home to 31 Ball Drop rooms featuring close-up views of the famous Times Square Ball. Paying homage to the city’s culinary heritage, the hotel’s signature restaurant and cocktail lounge, Highball, serves reimagined New York classics and handcrafted spirits and free-spirited cocktails, enjoyed both indoors and outdoors via an expansive outdoor terrace with spectacular views of Times Square. For more information, visit the hotel’s[website](https://www.hilton.com/en/hotels/nyctepo-tempo-new-york-times-square/) .

## About The Lost Boys


When Michael moves to California with his younger brother Sam and their mother Lucy, he’s desperate to leave his old life behind and start fresh. A wild night out on the boardwalk finds him in the shadows of Santa Carla and brings him face-to-face with David, the magnetic leader of a local rock band. David and his bandmates offer Michael freedom, adventure, and the connection he’s been longing to find. But when the band’s dark secret finally comes out, Michael must decide how far he’s willing to go to belong.


Get ready for the ride of your life with *The Lost Boys* , the most Tony Award-winning new musical of the year. It’s a “thrilling, blockbuster event” (People), “a breathtaking adventure unlike any musical seen before” (New York Post), and “the best new musical of the season” (The Washington Post).


*The Lost Boys* is “a jaw-dropping, rock-fueled must-see” (Cosmopolitan) featuring Tony-winning performances from Shoshana Bean and Ali Louis Bourzgui. Directed by three-time Tony winner Michael Arden, the production features music and lyrics by The Rescues, a book by David Hornsby and Chris Hoch, choreography by Lauren Yalango-Grant and Christopher Cree Grant, and music supervision by Ethan Popp.
